statement: An isolated finite labelled multiple fibre retains its exact multiplicity and a smooth normalized torus root chart in a one-sided smooth specialization
depends_on: E.2.10-E.2.12; Cartier multiplicity identity; normalized etale root cover
notes: Root and D full-source referee PASS. The normalized root cover is etale over the smooth total space even if the central divisor was initially singular. This proposition concerns the finite chart; the cusp is recovered separately in E.2.16-E.2.20.

statement: The normalized delta field and its effective semifree circle action extend across a one-sided smooth specialization; finite-root collapsed targets are impossible
depends_on: E.1.3; E.2.1; E.2.10-E.2.12; compact averaging; equivariant Ehresmann
notes: Root and D full-source referee PASS. The fixed P1 retains normal O(-1) plus O(-1). A constant nonreal second period would give a nontrivial holomorphic elliptic action with a fixed point, impossible. Ordinary tori with only one delta period are handled separately by E.2.15.
